## Meaning

This monitor fired because extrapolating the recent trend, the resource is projected to cross its limit inside the forecast horizon. It has NOT crossed it yet — the lead time is the point of this alert.

Query:

```
max(next_1d):forecast(avg:runtime.memory.heap_used_pct{__SCOPE__} by {service}, 'linear', 1, interval='30m', history='1w') > 0.92
```

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-app-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `remediate-recycle-app-pool` (approval required) runs when triggered.

Actions: `capture_memory_dump`, `request_approval`, `recycle_process`, `verify_recovery`.

Guardrails before anything is changed:

- refuses if in-flight request count exceeds the drain threshold
- refuses during an active change freeze

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `sre` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `platform-leadership`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
